independence.method: One direct visual inspection of the named original PNG, before any author material. Approximate pixel coordinates are observations, not exact geometric constraints.

subfigures.description: One spatial drawing, no panels, axes, grid, measurements, numerical values, arrowheads or right-angle glyph.

facts.description: One approximately round closed outline, centered visually near (172,229). The lower and left portions are solid; the upper and right portions behind the oblique plane are dashed. The solid/dashed transitions are near (121,87) and (317,269).
facts.unresolvedMeaning: Pixels alone do not distinguish a sphere silhouette from a circle. Do not assign a 3D circle-incidence assertion from this outline.

facts.description: An oblique quadrilateral with solid edges, approximate vertices (138,14), (391,160), (362,295), (107,149). It overlaps the round outline. Its lower edge crosses the dashed B-O-A line at an unlabelled, unmarked crossing near (201,202).
facts.label: alpha
facts.labelLocation: Near (353,176), in the right part of the quadrilateral
facts.unresolvedMeaning: The printed alpha labels the oblique frame; no filled region or additional ruling is printed.

facts.description: A dark point marker at the meeting of the dashed B-O-A line and solid line a, labelled A on its right/upper-right.
facts.label: A

facts.description: A dark endpoint marker at the lower-left end of the dashed B-O-A line, labelled B below/right.
facts.label: B

facts.description: A dark point marker on the dashed B-O-A line between B and A, near the visual center of the round outline, labelled O below/right.
facts.label: O

facts.description: One dashed straight segment from B through O to A, ascending rightward. O appears approximately midway. No solid continuation beyond B or A and no arrowhead are printed.
facts.unresolvedMeaning: The pixels support collinearity/order and approximate midpoint, but the name diameter and exact equality need edition text.

facts.description: One solid straight segment in the oblique frame from an unlabelled upper-edge point near (208,54), through A, to an unlabelled lower-edge point near (284,249). It slopes down/right and is labelled a immediately right of its lower portion.
facts.label: a
facts.unresolvedMeaning: Pixels show the crossing at A, not an explicit right-angle glyph or exact Euclidean perpendicularity.

relations.observation: B, O, A lie on the same dashed segment in that order.
A is the shared printed meeting point of B-O-A and a, located inside the plane frame.
Both unlabelled ends of a meet opposite upper/lower frame edges. Neither end has a printed dot, name, measurement or arrow.
The upper/right round outline is dashed, the lower/left outline solid. Plane edges remain solid through their overlaps; do not add hidden plane edges or extra sphere curves.
The lower frame edge crosses B-O-A and meets the outline without extra named intersection points. The upper-left frame edge crosses the outline without an extra named point.

absencesAndLimits: Only A, B, O are named point labels; only a and alpha name a line and plane.
No extra radii, chords, circles, grid, coordinate axes, dimensions, equality ticks, angle arcs, tangency glyph or right-angle box.
A and B are interior to the 2D silhouette; do not force either onto the projected outline or infer a missing circumference segment.
No proof text or answer is encoded in the image.
Mathematical center, sphere, diameter, tangent line, tangent plane and perpendicularity are deferred until edition text is read.
mapping: Deliberately deferred until this file is made read-only and its stat/hash receipt is captured.
